name: GetFirstFreeRowOrColumnIndexNode
label: Get First Free Row or Column Index
description: Gets the first free row or column index based on the search direction in an Excel worksheet.
author: @aventisia

fields.name: SearchDirection
fields.label: Search Direction
fields.description: Specifies whether to search for the first free row or the first free column.

fields.name: Column
fields.label: Column
fields.description: The column to search in when looking for the first free row. Accepts a column letter (e.g., 'A') or a 1-based index (e.g., '1').

fields.name: Row
fields.label: Row
fields.description: The row to search in when looking for the first free column.

fields.name: FirstFreeIndex
fields.label: First Free Index
fields.description: The index of the first free row or column.

fields.name: FirstFreeColumnName
fields.label: First Free Column Name
fields.description: The letter name of the first free column when searching by columns; otherwise empty.
